question: If A is the father of B and B is the father of C, then how is C related to A?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/900b05d6518cb6f6bb73f03dcebf0a654dd030242b70b57f41fa5bdac9c07d49.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88e478b19f185d1144e3a86652f4ab9de05421de69f9bc6577daf25b32682586.png] 

Clearly, C is the grandchild of A.

Hence, ‘**Grandchild**’ is the correct answer.
